Frontier node architecture

Frontier is operated by Oak Ridge National Laboratory in United States. This profile covers the documented compute inventory.

Cluster interconnect: HPE Slingshot 11 · 200 Gb/s per NIC. Topology: Dragonfly.

Scope and uncertainty

Each MI250X has two GPU compute dies: four physical accelerators appear as eight logical GPU devices. Diagram counts physical accelerators.

Not verified means a detail has not been confirmed in this catalog. Diagrams are schematic; node indices are illustrative, not physical hostnames. Data checked 13 September 2026.
